content: Uler làböl a in'kɔk a Nzam

Kyakin, mɛ an'pà un'kanà akà andweer a Ikööŋ abà uboo a bɛ. Mɛ sye in'wà un'dweer asànaa ba, anà in'wà mbäl a mpay a Klistɔ, mɛ mbuur in'we anà kab a làkoo alà làsàmɛnà. Le undiir in'lɔɔmà mɛ akà ba:
Làdii làböl a in'kɔk kàlapɛ Nzam, twon làler la a un'kaak a ngwal wanswà, wɛɛ unsà mpem aŋàbwaŋ asànaa ukwen Nzam, twon lan'kyer ntɔn muleŋ bweel, wɛɛ unsà ukwen.
Twon làyaal baar abà bàlapɛ muler a un'kaak a ngwal abɛ, wɛɛ làkäl mbaan ntɔn in'kɔk.
Kyakin, bɛ làsàwal mpà a làkoo mpa isàbi ubwaŋ aya akà ikikye umpal usàyà Nkum a aseey.

Mbwo mwɛy, bɛ atö anà asye, làkäl anà unkyeey akà andweer. Anà bɛ banswà, làkäl anà làbɔ̈ɔ̈n unsà nkääl abɛ, bɛ a bɛ, ntɔn « Nzam afàtɔn aŋun'yɔl, wɛɛ nde afàswaŋ ubwaŋ ande akà aŋàlàbɔ̈ɔ̈n. »
Abun, làsi làbɔ̈ɔ̈n ungyɛl a kɔɔ a ngwal a Nzam, waa nde usàlasɛɛn taaŋ kàsi nde,
làpɛ nkyɛɛr abɛ yanswà akà nde, ntɔn nde mbuur afàlabɔŋ.
Làduub mii abɛ, làkäl unsà igyɛɛŋ! ntɔn ŋankir abɛ, ileŋ, wàmuyileŋ asànaa nkwee a umpɔr ayileŋ mbuur adyà.
Lumbäär, làkäl aŋàtsim unsà làkwikilà abɛ. Làyöb naa mpay nsil yayi bàpɛ akà atɔŋ abɛ abà u mɛɛn.

Nzam, aŋangyɛb yanswà awà kàlabel unsà làkoo ande là mbul a in'tye u mbwo a Klistɔ, nde ŋakwo asàlapà ngwal ungö a kitaaŋ làsàman bɛ mpay, nde akyer asàlatsiim, asàlatsümà udu a in'bään a ngwal.
Wɛy ikɔ̈b ikäl anà nde mbul a in'tye! Wöö wöö!
Mɛ kàlasöön bingɔk bi u mbwo a Silàvɛ, awà in'fàwal mɛ asànaa un'tɔŋ a lää, ntɔn mukàlalɛɛl anà mutà imbäl naa yà unsà kab a ngway a Nzam làndandaa waa bɛ làbaŋàtsim.
Iköŋ a aklistɔ akyà pà u Babilɔn, kyàmàlatööm mbɔr, anà Malakɔ, mwan amɛ.
Làpɛɛl mbɔr a un'kaay a atɔŋ bɛ a bɛ. Wɛy duu làkäl anà bɛ banswà làbà amu Klistɔ!
